data.one_liner: Creates animated backgrounds and visual elements for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to easily integrate customizable animated backgrounds such as scrolling shapes, gradients, waves, and lava lamp effects into their Flutter applications. It provides prebuilt backgrounds and supports applying animations to full screens or smaller individual widgets.
use_when: You want to add animated backgrounds or visual effects to your screens.
You need customizable scrolling shapes, faders, waves, or lava lamp animations.
You want to apply background animations to specific smaller widgets like buttons.
avoid_when: You require complex high-performance game engines or heavy particle physics.
Your project targets older versions of Flutter below 3.27 or Dart below 3.6.1.
strengths: Provides multiple prebuilt animated backgrounds and customizable painter data.
Can be used on entire screens or constrained to individual widgets using standard layout constraints.
Supports stacking multiple backgrounds for unique visual combinations.
weaknesses: Limited to specific animated background styles (scrollers, faders, waves, lava lamps).
High-frequency full-screen animations may impact performance on low-end devices.
